final_answer: The prize for Kingdom Rush winning Uruguay's national video game contest was a sale of the game on iOS to celebrate a big iOS update featuring Retina Graphics for the new iPad, Heroes characters, new challenges, and Greenmuck the evil Treant in the new Rotten Forest Stage.
